headline: Weathered Expanse Erupts As Coastal Clashes Flare In Fisherman's Row
war_summary: Weathered Expanse has erupted into fierce combat with nine strategic base exchanges over the past six hours around Crow’s Nest and Frostmarch, generating nearly 2,800 casualties in the last two hours alone. Western coastal actions have reignited in Fisherman’s Row and Farranac Coast, where renewed skirmishing at Fort Ember and Transient Valley brought recent base turnovers. In Stonecradle, direct base contests have paused following earlier clashes over Buckler Sound, yet intense fighting persists with over 2,900 casualties recorded in the two-hour window. Mooring County and Dead Lands have both awakened with surging casualty rates, as Warden losses spike sharply across the central ruins. Conversely, Callahan’s Passage and The Gutter have subsided into relative quiet, with frontline shifts stalling after earlier engagements. Across Linn of Mercy, territorial lines remain static despite continued attrition around Rotdust and Lathair.
